mods.menu.new.mod.description:
Here you can merge multiple compatible mods into one mod and install them. Please make sure to check compatibility and installation order yourself, as this tool only handles the installation.
Possible inputs can be a path to a .zip file or a folder path, e.g. a Workshop (file mod) path.

default.mods.menu.title: Default Mods Settings
default.mods.menu.subtext:
In "Default Mods" you can store mods that remain permanently active, even when no mods are active.
These mods are always loaded last. Only small mods are recommended, nothing that affects multiplayer.
!!! Use at your own risk !!!
